source: This is why “use fewer registers” and “maximize occupancy” are not general optimization rules. AS09 will treat that interaction directly. Here the memory lesson is simpler: a finite register budget decides how much thread-private state can remain at the closest level of the hierarchy.
zh: 这就是为什么“使用更少的寄存器”和“最大化占用”不是通用的优化规则。 AS09 将直接处理该交互。这里的内存教训更简单：有限的寄存器预算决定了在层次结构的最接近的级别可以保留多少线程私有状态。
